user.title: Connect to Local Roborock S6
user.description: Configure local UDP connection (port 54321) to your Roborock S6. Xiaomi Cloud fields are optional and only used to refresh cached .rrmap files.

data.xiaomi_country: Xiaomi Cloud Server Country (de, cn, us, sg)
data.xiaomi_user_id: Xiaomi User ID (optional for map refresh)
data.xiaomi_service_token: Xiaomi Service Token (optional for map refresh)
data.xiaomi_ssecurity: Xiaomi ssecurity Key (optional for map refresh)

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the vacuum over UDP port 54321.
error.invalid_token: Token must be a valid 32-character hexadecimal string.

abort.already_configured: This Roborock S6 vacuum is already configured.
